description.p: Pencil is a rich text editor for the COSMIC desktop. It edits a document rather than a text buffer: headings are headings, lists are lists, and a document saved as HTML and reopened is the same document, not an approximation of one.

ul.li: Open and save Markdown, MDC, MDX, HTML and plain text
Format with the keyboard, a toolbar, or Markdown shortcuts as you type
Find and replace, matching loosely, by case, by whole word, or by regular expression
Show an outline of the document's headings

description.p: There is no web engine anywhere in it. Text is laid out by the same engine as the rest of the desktop, so a word is the same width here as it is in every other COSMIC application.
